notes.title: Demofeature-Update and Bugfix
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors!

With the recent update to version 02_0225_08, 2 new features have been added to the demo.


What's new?

 Steam achievements have been added to the game (currently 9; more coming soon).
 A high score list is now available, featuring the "Top 10 Combos" and "Top 10 High Scores."



Additionally, a minor bug with the randomized playback of the music playlist has been fixed.
Songs should now be selected with more variety.

Have fun "Beatstomping"!
Best regards,
WB
